derivation.onset: Record reports ICANS but no qualifying finding exists (no ICE below 10, no consciousness or other criterion), so section 7.9(c)/A22 applies. Onset is 7.1 only if a formal Grade 0 assessment is on the record's onset date (Day +4); there is none (only 'confused', no ICE), so 7.4. The sub-threshold symptom on that date also earns the A24 flag.
derivation.max_grade: Section 7.9(c): no qualifying finding gives 7.3 (record Grade 2 unsupported), the notes only describe ungradeable symptoms (section 7.3 definition). No documented 'not assessable' period exists, so A25 does not turn it into 7.4.

ambiguity_notes: Documented grade is reported as undetermined: the formal ICE 10/10 assessments are Grade 0, but under missing != absent they do not prove no ICANS on other days, and 'confused'/'disoriented ... agitated' are ungradeable symptoms. If a reviewer reads the documented grade as 0, the category (7.3) is unchanged. Acetaminophen for headache and fever with tocilizumab are not relevant competing causes.
